programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: 「大概人的所有喜歡都是來自後天，所有的熟悉感，都是與童年的某個記憶有關。」來自湖南的新移民圓圓及妹妹兩個人在香港成長，兩姊妹除了面對身份認同、貧窮，還有一個更大的命題：一個長年吸毒的父親。 從小父親若即若離，喜怒無常，又時常因坐牢突然消失，使兩姐妹長期處於不安。小時候她們還會討好父親，中學她們掌握了話語權開始反抗、掙扎、逃離。長大後本以為可以徹底掙脫父親，卻發現自己喜歡的所有人事，原來都帶著父親的影子，都與童年的某個回憶有關...

programme.title: Sigabo[Live]
programme.desc: The series explores the stark contrast in the lives of two individuals: Gabo (Martin), a spunky, street-smart man from a vibrant, humble community, and Samantha (Montes), a tough, fearless law enforcer from a highly affluent and privileged background. It blends action, romance, and comedy as their paths cross and their different worlds collide.

programme.title: The Alibi[Live]
programme.desc: Vincent, an heir to a news empire, gets accused of killing his rival, Walter. To protect his reputation, he hires Stella, an escort with her own haunted past, to pose as his alibi. What begins as a transactional arrangement soon becomes dangerously real as their shared wounds and ambitions draw them together. But when they uncover the truth, the two are compelled to confront their true feelings.

programme.title: E4 - Web of Life
programme.desc: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

programme.title: E4 - Crowded Islands
programme.desc: On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. programme.title: E5 - Return to the Wild
programme.desc: The Eastern Cape Province is investing heavily in ecotourism and conservation as an alternative to fishing and commercial development. programme.title: E1 - Earth

programme.title: A Moment Of Romance
programme.desc: Wah Dee handles cars and bikes like a racing champion. To keep the police off his trail, he takes Jo Jo hostage. On the run, their desperate love is doomed from the start....

programme.title: Fantasy Romance
programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives...

programme.title: Mr Fortune
programme.desc: Toy designer Yau is always bullied by boss and ex-girlfriend. One day, Yau runs into a beautiful but rebellious girl named Ching, who tells him she is the target of triad harassment. Yau is determined to help her, and he resigns from his job at the encouragement of Ching. The two take low-pay jobs at a fast-food chain, and gradually fall in love with each other, but their relationship is threatened when Ching's true identity as the daughter of a tycoon is exposed...

programme.title: Suspect
programme.desc: Due to a hypnosis murder case, a former policeman Guo WenBin with hyperthymesia gets involved with a highly intelligent murderer challenging judicial justice. The suspect openly challenges the law and claims to be a vigilante, using bizarre means to eradicate violence. There is panic among the general public, with lives at stake and much doubt floating around. With his extraordinary memory, he works hard to uncover the mystery of this police-versus-criminal game. Hypnotized at the decisive moment, he uses his subconscious to fight against the instigation of his dark side “Suspect Zero”. He uncovers the truth about the murder and the tragedy behind it, curbing the dark side of human nature and upholding judicial justice. While redeeming himself, he also brings the real culprit to justice.

programme.title: E9 - JJ's Birthday Party Fun
programme.desc: Get ready to party with JJ on his special day! The animals are setting up a surprise, but it's not going to plan. Enjoy a game of musical chairs, a party at the farm, a dino-themed birthday for Cody, and a magical birthday train ride!

programme.title: E5 - Imagination & Problem Solving Fun!
programme.desc: Join Baby John for some imagination & problem-solving fun! Oh no, Teddy is missing! But don't worry, Mom, Dad, Jack & Jill are all there to help Baby John search for him & solve the mystery. Then, dressed as pigs, Baby John, Jack & Jill use their imagination to re-enact the classic 'Three Little Pigs' story, with Dad playing the Big Bad Wolf! The problem-solving continues as the family helps guide Jill through the experience of losing her first tooth.

programme.title: E14 - Baby John's Birthday Blocks
programme.desc: Join Baby John for a day of birthday fun! He gets new building blocks, figures out the shapes of his presents, and has a messy party in the park. Plus, his sister Jill celebrates her birthday on a pink party bus!

programme.title: E3 - A Big Playtime Sing-Along!
programme.desc: Get ready for a big playtime sing-along with Mia & Max! First, they play a fun fishing game in the garden with Mummy & Daddy, learning their colors as they catch different colored fish. Then, Mia & Maple learn to play together by setting up a super cute tea party with all their cuddly toys. The playtime fun continues as Mia & Max pretend to be puppies, crawling & barking while singing the classic song 'BINGO!' with their parents.

programme.title: E3 - Baby John's Fun Animal Playtime!
programme.desc: Get ready for some fun animal playtime with Baby John! He & Manny are playing with their animal toys & a bus. With the help of their imagination, they travel into a fantastic animal world where their toys become real! Then, Baby John has fun in his play pretend veterinary clinic, treating his dog Bingo as one of his patients. The animal fun continues as the family tries to give a very stinky Bingo a bath!

programme.title: E40
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: E25
programme.desc: 朱韻剛開始大學生活，就被“壞小子”李峋的闖入徹底顛覆了世界。被朱韻當成不學無術富家子的他，真實身份竟是學校破格錄取的特招生，難得一見的編程天才。兩人在幾次交鋒後，對彼此都有些賞識。學長方志靖對朱韻多次刁難，李峋出手維護朱韻，還邀她加入了自己組建的備賽隊伍，代表學校贏得了重大編程比賽。在相處中，兩人情感日益升溫

programme.desc: 朱韻剛開始大學生活，就被“壞小子”李峋的闖入徹底顛覆了世界。被朱韻當成不學無術富家子的他，真實身份竟是學校破格錄取的特招生，難得一見的編程天才。兩人在幾次交鋒後，對彼此都有些賞識。學長方志靖對朱韻多次刁難，李峋出手維護朱韻，還邀她加入了自己組建的備賽隊伍，代表學校贏得了重大編程比賽。在相處中，兩人情感日益升溫

programme.title: E30
programme.desc: 故事講述了周筱風（趙又廷 飾）、方筱然（毛曉彤 飾）和林逸（金世佳 飾）三位心臟科醫生機緣巧合下，在東立醫院心臟中心相遇。三人因專業背景、職業理念不同而產生摩擦碰撞，隨後在治病救人的過程中逐漸磨合達成默契，最終在生命戰場並肩作戰的故事。
